item.title: Wood Stork Soars Off Endangered Species List Following State Recovery Success
item.description: In a landmark victory for wildlife conservation, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service officially announced today that the wood stork has been removed from the federal list of endangered and threatened wildlife.
